description: 指定避難所・指定緊急避難場所 [evacuation shelters and public facilities] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 武雄市. 指定避難所・指定緊急避難場所の一覧データです。 指定緊急避難場所の一覧はオープンデータ推奨データセット形式です。. Coverage: 武雄市. The portal files it under the publisher 武雄市. Its tags are 位置情報, 避難場所, 避難所, 防災. It offers 2 resource(s) in xlsx. The portal shows 2020-11-27 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
